items.title: Louis Barbarin Interview, 1960-06-22
items.q: Well, they had my dad, Mario Perez, Ernest Rapana, Eddie Sherry... Ernest Rapana was a snare drum player. Bass drum player.

ctx.x: Well, they had my dad, Mario Perez, Ernest Rapana, Eddie Sherry, you heard of him. I believe Adolf Alexander.
Let's get the instruments too, I'm confused. Now, Eddie Sherry played what?
